decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates sit close to the core glass-wafer business, so keeping them costs little, and their value in 3D integration and high-frequency applications is still uncertain but promising, which makes keeping the option open worthwhile.

The laser-based through-glass-via structuring was launched only in 2024 with a dedicated page and targets the growing glass-core packaging market, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved and the option has high upside, which justifies keeping it and committing further.
